explanation: This pole reads a completed word: it is high on a token that finishes a lexical word (a whole-word token such as ' one', ' important', ' consists', ' believed', ' easy', or the last piece of a multi-token word) and near zero on a token that is continued inside the same word (the first or middle piece of a split word, e.g. 'eng' and 'ag' at 0.0 in 'engagements', which is why Polish, Italian and Tamil text, whose words are cut into such fragments, leaves it at 0.00-0.01). Within completed words it is strongest on a predicate head right after a copula or auxiliary ('is one'/'was one' 3.2-3.6, 'is important' 2.6, 'are also known', 'believed to be' 3.6, 'consists of' 3.2) and weakest on function words that cannot head a predicate ('by', 'for', 'to', 'or' after 'was' sit at 0.0-0.4).
